gaps.explanation: No business-type schedule exists; the Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds (printed p21) prints enterprise columns 'Electric Fund' and 'Water Fund' on trimmed p8 and 'Sewer Fund' and 'Nursing Home Fund' (plus Total) on trimmed p9. JSON receipts = total operating revenues 366,006 + interest income 58,272. Electric: Lease revenues 99,158 + Interest income 6,043 = 105,201. Water: Sales 153,380 + Other revenue 148 + Interest income 25,016 = 178,544. Sewer: Sales 109,320 + Interest income 20,692 = 130,012. Nursing Home: Lease revenues 4,000 + Interest income 6,521 = 10,521. 0 + 105,201 + 178,544 + 130,012 + 10,521 = 424,278 = statement total. (Governmental Loan proceeds 2,965,000 are printed among Street Fund revenues on p5 and are already in the Street Fund schedule; no debt_proceeds row.)
